programmes.d: A respected rancher is found to have been the notoriously cruel commandant of a Civil War prison camp.
An Army major threatens to put Dodge under martial law after soldiers are killed in a robbery.
Matt Dillon persuades Dodge City-ites to give the silent treatment to a criminal he cannot convict. (TV-PG)
A girl refuses to testify against the robbers who kidnapped her.
Matt suspects foul play when an old farmer claims his wife left him.
Matt and Chester act as decoys to ambush outlaws that are masking their crimes as those of renegade Indians.
Four escaped convicts capture Marshal Matt Dillon and hold him hostage in their flight to the Mexican border.
A love-smitten Chester, with an eye to marriage, takes up farming on an arid, unyielding piece of Kansas ground.
Matt seems to be too lazy to catch horse thieves when ranchers are being sold stolen horses.
The widow of a man slain in a gunfight with Marshal Dillon swears to avenge her husband's death. (TV-PG)
United States Marshal Matt Dillon of Dodge City must deal with fast trigger-happy outlaw Dan Grat (Paul Richards) who wants his way with the town.
Matt is reluctant to tell Cherry O'Dell that her husband's been killed.
Nothing goes right for Chester when he tries to earn extra money to keep his crooked Uncle Sunday Meachem out of Dodge City.
A beautiful young wife (Lola Albright) manipulates a young hired hand into killing her older husband.
A dying man claims that a friend of Matt's is a bank robber.
A man nearly kills a couple on their way to Dodge.
A dying storekeeper's last word is Matt's only clue to finding the man who killed him.
Festus Haggen's gun-toting Aunt Thede gets into immediate trouble when she comes to Dodge City.
A self-described religious prophet makes life miserable for his sister and her husband.
Marshal Matt Dillon is forced to arrest for murder the son of one of his closest friends.
Matt is delivering a prisoner to Dodge when he is thrown, and must stay with his quarry while Chester gets help.
An ex-outlaw's attempt to hang up his gun proves difficult.
Matt attempts to rescue a child's father from kidnappers.
The new saloonkeeper in Dodge is a woman who knows how to handle a six-shooter.
Twin brothers try to kill all Indians.

Townspeople protect an outlaw they believe has reformed.

A peddler's miracle curative contains opium and proves fatal.

An untamed nature girl develops a liking for Marshal Matt Dillon and isn't shy about expressing it.
A pretty, blind girl influences deputy Newly O'Brien's efforts to arrest a horse thief.
A stranger is purchasing all the local freight lines.
After a young gunfighter brazenly kills an over-matched rancher, the rancher's brother wants Matt to settle the score.
